pages.title: Requirements
pages.text: First defeat the vanilla Ender Dragon so its central return portal exists. The ritual leader must stand nearby while wearing an authentic Apep's Crown with an authority tag.$(br2)A Creative or command-issued crown is not accepted.

pages.title: Fountain Offerings
pages.text: Throw into the central return portal:$(br)$(li)15 Embers of Duat$(li)5 Dragon's Breath$(li)3 Heka Radiant Crystals$(br2)These three ritual items are kept from travelling through the vanilla portal. After they settle briefly, the rite detects and consumes the full cost.

pages.title: Overwriting the Return
pages.text: The rite lasts four seconds, accompanied by thunder, shockwaves, and a dynastic portal frame. On completion, the vanilla return portal is replaced by a horizontal Gateway to the Silent Court.

pages.title: Three Entries
pages.text: Each trip from the End into the gateway consumes one of three world-wide entry charges. Returning from the Silent Void does not consume another charge.$(br2)At zero, the gateway vanishes and the vanilla return portal is restored.

pages.title: The Silent Void
pages.text: The Silent Void has no natural terrain. Its build height runs from -64 to 320, and mod-rendered fog blankets the dimension. Arrival uses a protected platform, with the Dynasty Grand Cathedral nearby.
